name: Restricted Admissible-Law Grammar v0
purpose: Target-independent decidable grammar for Path A retained-state / transport laws.

types.NodeZeroSumScalar: N0 = node scalar fields with total sum zero
types.RetainedState: R = compact retained state generated before target scoring
types.ProbeFamily: Q = admissible observer probes in N0
types.Operator: linearized map from probes to edge/node response

primitive_observables_allowed: incidence/boundary operator d from graph topology
prior retained state rho_n in R
ordered-slice index only as update order, not time primitive
capacity pressure chi_pre computed before target solve
accessibility/observer response measured by locked probe map
primitive_observables_forbidden: target transport residual chosen after seeing target
learned latent vector without first-principles update law
allowed_operations: finite bounded monotone scalar constitutive map sigma from predeclared family Sigma
convex energy minimization when energy is determined by sigma and conservation
gauge projection to zero-mean node potentials
admissibility projection only if defined independently of target score
forbidden_operations: neural net / RNN / autoencoder latent law
post-hoc choice of observables/residuals after seeing target
running the target joint solve as a null reconstruction

complexity_measure.definition: expression-tree cost over allowed primitives and operations

equivalence_relation: orientation convention changes preserving edge flow sign consistency
graph relabeling preserving incidence and ordered-update relations
retained-state gauge transformations preserving order/provenance relation
constitutive parameterization changes that produce identical operator/action on all admissible probes
enumeration_procedure: enumerate expression trees by increasing complexity
reject any tree containing forbidden primitives or operations
reject any tree failing conservation/source-current compatibility
reject any tree requiring target future operator or K_ab as input
group expressions by declared equivalence relation
test minimal survivors on prequential heldout ordered-slice challenges

first_solved_law_family.name: FC-CL: finite-capacity conserved-current law family
law: sigma in Sigma: odd, monotone, bounded, sigma(0)=0, sigma'(0)=1
first_solved_law_family.linearized_transport_operator: O_b(q) = response under d diag(a ⊙ sigma'((a⊙d*phi_b)/c)) d*
first_solved_law_family.claim: This law family formalizes the 57.3B/57.3C finite-capacity joint field without claiming retained-state or gravity closure.

open_subobject.reason: RAG-0 does not yet force a unique endogenous retained-provenance update law.
